bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-architecture generalization by compressing datasets using a specific model architecture (e.g., ResNet-18) and then measuring the accuracy drop when training unseen neural network architectures (e.g., ViT, Swin, ConvNeXt) on the synthesized or compressed datasets.

Mathematically analyzing submodular gains and visually comparing feature distributions via t-SNE to demonstrate how traditional coreset algorithms over-sample data from high-density regions and lack diversity.
